findings.title: CI failure: README.md has multiple consecutive blank lines (MD012)
findings.detail: The 'CI' workflow on master failed on 2026-09-23 (run ID 35813238608). markdownlint-cli2 reported README.md:74 MD012/no-multiple-blanks — two consecutive blank lines where only one is allowed. The file ends with a double blank line after the Repobeats analytics image.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the trailing extra blank line at the end of README.md (line 74)

findings.title: Jekyll is one major version behind (3.9.3 installed, 4.4.1 latest)
findings.detail: Gemfile pins jekyll to '~> 3.9.3'. Latest stable release is 4.4.1. Jekyll 4 has breaking changes (Liquid 5 required, dropped Ruby < 2.5), so upgrading requires testing. Other notably behind gems: liquid (4.0.4 vs 5.14.0), rouge (3.26.0 vs 5.1.0), rack (2.2.24 vs 3.2.7, intentionally pinned for sinatra compat).
findings.suggested_fix: Update Gemfile to 'gem "jekyll", "~> 4.4"' and resolve transitive dependency conflicts

findings.title: bundler-audit not available; security advisory check skipped
findings.detail: The bundler-audit gem was not installed in this environment and 'gem install' was not permitted. The Gemfile already contains recent security pins for webrick (>= 1.8.2), rack (~> 2.2.23), addressable (>= 2.9.0), and concurrent-ruby (>= 1.3.7). A manual 'bundle audit check --update' is recommended.
findings.suggested_fix: Run 'gem install bundler-audit && bundle audit check --update' in the project environment
